overview: How I Met Your Mother, the Russian comedy series produced by the company Good Story Media, which is an adaptation of the eponymous American television series How I Met Your Mother. The main character of the series, Dima Nosov, in the distant 2034, tells his teenage children about his own youth, as well as the life stories of his friends. Dima describes the circumstances in which he met his future wife. At the same time, he dwells on various events that took place in his life at that time with him and his friends: Pasha Vinogradov, Lucy Lyubimova, Yury Sadovskiy, and Katya Krivchik. The main action of the series takes place in Moscow today (in 1st season - in 2008–2009).
title: Как я встретил вашу маму

overview: Set in the future, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom is tasked with restoring reality after he breaks a device built by Sheldon, Leonard and Howard, accidentally bringing about a multiverse Armageddon. Stuart is aided in this quest by his girlfriend Denise, geologist friend Bert, and quantum physicist/all-around pain in the ass Barry Kripke. Along the way, they meet alternate-universe versions of characters we've come to know and love from The Big Bang Theory. As the title implies, things don't go well.
title: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe

overview: Get Hooked is a 6-part documentary series that explores diverse joy in fishing and nature.
title: Get Hooked

overview: This four-part series explores the history of science fiction in the atomic age. It looks at the creation of the atomic bomb by J. Robert Oppenheimer and others, the Cold War, and the many varieties of science fiction expression in all media. Richly illustrated and with a specially written orchestral score, this powerful series will inspire, shock, engage and entertain, with its evocative description of visions of the future expressed in the greatest works of science fiction.
title: Science Fiction in the Atomic Age

overview: Más Fuerte Que Nunca will feature exclusive interviews with leading personalities from the entertainment world, content creators, singers, actors, producers, celebrities, and public figures. These guests will share anecdotes and reflections about their careers, personal lives, and experiences beyond the spotlight. María Celeste Arrarás will reveal who's really behind the big names from a more human and sincere perspective.
title: Más Fuerte Que Nunca

overview: To the outside world, the Jordan sisters, Cherish (Keri Hilson) and Roxy (Keshia Chant ) are the hottest singing duo on the charts… but behind closed doors, sibling rivalry runs deep. After returning to their hotel one night, the sisters' penthouse is the target of a frightening jewel heist. Investigators believe the robbery was an inside job and rumors spread that Roxy secretly planned and staged the crime. Will the sisters put aside their lust for the spotlight… or will they let their temptation for fame tear them apart for good?
title: Temptations

overview: The series about love, friendship and schizophrenia. What to do if you are a student, wearing glasses, in love with the most beautiful girl in the school? How do you get the attention of a beautiful women, if she already has a handsome man with his own wheels and money?
title: Зайцев+1

overview: In How Can We Help newly elected congressman Jimmy Choi causes all kinds of messes for his intrepid staff—none of whom voted for him.
title: How Can We Help

overview: Almost Paradise focuses on your everyday, normal married couple facing all the everyday, normal challenges of being stranded on a desert Island for decades. Think Blue Lagoon, the family sitcom.
title: Almost Paradise

overview: A cheerful and passionate youth drama about associate lawyers who go to work at Seocho-dong Law Town every day. It is a realistic story of 'real' lawyers who have stepped into the real world and will portray the coming of age of lawyers in charge of cases that can happen in and around our daily lives. An Ju Hyeong is a 9th-year lawyer with a high level of fact-violence logic. He became a lawyer simply because he found logic and cases interesting. From the beginning, he did not have the 'meaning' that lawyers protect the weak, implement justice, and change the world. He is just a 9th office worker. He has been a regular at the same company for 9 years without changing jobs, and his work is at its peak as his seniority. He is a veteran in the associate industry who has set a new associate salary record but does not open a practice because it is too much trouble. For Ju Hyeong, the peaceful wall of the 'workplace' begins to crack. Kang Hui Ji is a 2nd-year lawyer at Johwa Law Firm. She believes that " if you change one person's life, you have changed that person's world." Whether she is lacking or overflowing, she is confident and honest.
title: Law and the City

overview: When respect collapses in schools, a special unit arrives to set things right — with sharp, no-nonsense lessons you won't find in textbooks.
title: Teach You a Lesson

overview: Five young adults travel to a special clinic run by the infamous Dr. Andover to treat their phobias. One by one their worst fears begin to manifest themselves and intrude into each patient's reality. Is Dr. Andover's cure worse than the disease?
title: Fear Clinic

overview: Six strangers are shown into a dining room. They're introduced by the host (referred to as "The Devil's Broker"), and have a brief chat over a pre-dinner glass of wine. The contestants then rank each other from favourite down to least favourite, and the person with the worst rank leaves without even sampling the soup. The remaining five sit down for dinner, and are spotted £1,000 for their prize pool. In turn, each will be asked a question intended to reveal something about themself. For instance, "Who out of four categories of people would you like to live next door to?" The other four pool their brains to predict what answer will be given, and a correct prediction adds £1,000 to the prize pool. Repeat this so each contestant faces a poser, a process that takes about half an hour. There's another elimination here, done almost at random. The contenders pick a card at random, one of the cards is marked. That person has to pick their favourite and least favourite contestants, and their least favoured is off the show. A final question is posed to one contender, where the answer is one of the other three players. There's another £1,000 in the prize fund for a correct answer, bringing the total prize money to a maximum of £7,000. Who wins this amount? The four remaining players rate each other again, and the contestant with the highest rating takes the money home.
title: The Devil's Dinner Party

overview: The protagonists Mike and Burák arrive in the small town of Janovy Lázně after a twelve-month stint behind bars to run a pub that Burák inherited from his uncle. Hot on their heels is a pesky probation officer who is waiting for their first step on the edge of the law to send them back behind bars. The pub is in a state of disrepair, however, and gastronomy is out of the question. And so Mike and Burák slowly start to get acquainted with the competition and potential new friends and lovers...
title: Ohnivý kuře

overview: Isak Dreyer has one rule of life: crazy ideas MUST be implemented. Like, for example, setting off on a crazy road trip with a hunting lodge in tow.
title: Isak og koia – en røverhistorie

overview: After multiple crises turn her life upside down, a convenience store clerk discovers a surprising creative outlet to restore her hope: stand-up comedy.
title: Forget You Not

overview: This thought-provoking documentary series examines the harrowing consequences of the Vietnam War, from the Gulf of Tonkin incident to the fall of Saigon.
title: Turning Point: The Vietnam War

overview: A dreaded gangster, his menacing aides and a political party with skeletons in its closet — there's a lot for Officer Arjun Maitra to navigate in Bengal.
title: Khakee: The Bengal Chapter

overview: After the Revolution, new people came to power in Russia, but it was too early to talk about a bright future. The enemies were defeated, but a new threat appeared: bandits. Criminals of all stripes felt complete impunity, robbing and killing even during the day. Yakov Koshelnikov's bandits instilled pure terror. They spared no one, and they were nicknamed "Koshelnikov" for their love of other people's property. Only investigator Trepalov dared to challenge the insolent gang. He and his loyal partners intend to catch the villains and punish them to the fullest extent of the law.
title: УГРОза: Трепалов и Кошелек

overview: After his son is beaten by a bully, a family man makes a split-second decision that threatens the course of his idyllic life forever.
title: Porządny człowiek

overview: First to the Finish - a New Docuseries Focused on the Relentless Pursuit of the MX-5 Cup Championship - Will Premiere March 25 on Prime Video From Boardwalk Pictures, First to the Finish follows the journey of two female racers and one female team owner through the exhilarating 2024 Mazda MX-5 Cup Championship Season
title: First to the Finish

overview: Léa, 28, is one of France's first female rabbis: frail shoulders, great responsibilities as she has to find answers in the labyrinth of small and big questions in people's lives. But how can she be a guide for others when she herself is grappling with the fundamentals of love, family and the millennial's quest for meaning?
title: Le Sens des Choses

overview: One of the most heart-rending stories of World War II. Forced into hiding, Anne records all in her diary, as her tale of fear, romance and treachery moves to a tragic ending.
title: The Diary of Anne Frank

overview: After Diana introduces Cassie to other members of the circle, they reveal themselves as witches, and that she is one as well. Initially, Cassie refuses to believe them - until Adam shows her how to unlock her magical powers. After Cassie reluctantly joins the circle, Adam, Diana, Faye, and the other members of the coven quickly discover that with Cassie in their circle, they are able to cast spells more powerful than they ever could before.
title: The Secret Circle

overview: Against the backdrop of 1990s Toronto, a Punjabi singer's journey from street performer to rising star leads him into dangerous territory.
title: Kanneda

overview: Strange things happen to influencer Han Da Bit from Anyeon University, starting with the nightmare that she has one day. Then one day, she sees Do Hee, a senior she runs into at school, and Da Bit feels a strange attraction. Da Bit, who follows her out of curiosity about Do Hee, enters a unique tarot shop.
title: The Witch's Eye

overview: Linen is a woman whose life was shattered after being sexually assaulted and left for dead. When she returns, though, she is no longer a victim. She has the opportunity to reinvent herself as Phrae, a woman determined to take revenge on those who destroyed her, using every means necessary to bring justice to herself.
title: Reclaim

overview: Talented Saville Row textile pattern designer Kate lives in the quaint village of Blexford, England, next door to her father Mac, who is long-divorced from Kate's mother Delilah, a globe-trotting American always on an adventure. When not at work, Kate looks after Mac, who's recovering from a motorbike accident and is inclined to spend his days sitting in his recliner. Unbeknownst to Kate, her best friend Laura signs her up for The 12 Dates of Christmas – a holiday-themed matchmaking program in the days leading up to the holiday featuring carefully curated, yuletide dating experiences, in an attempt to get Kate out of her rut. Lovingly coerced by Laura and longtime best friend Callum, a reluctant Kate ultimately gets into the spirit of the program and is caught off guard when she meets someone who reinvigorates her zest for life. But when Delilah unexpectedly shows up on her doorstep – literally – Kate and Mac's life and holiday season get upended. Meanwhile, Mac may be embarking on his own romance with local Evelyn, a widow who slowly helps him step outside the confines of his house and open his heart. As Kate wends her way through the 12 dates, she takes a circuitous route to romance while also making some important discoveries about herself.
title: Twelve Dates 'Til Christmas

overview: Magic City has been a legendary Atlanta institution and the launchpad for countless Hip-Hop artists since 1985, leading to the club's reputation as the "Black Studio 54." Now, for the first time, Magic City: An American Fantasy tells the full tale of the storied club's rise to global prominence and how it became the definitive king-maker in the hip-hop community, catering to high-profile celebrities such as 2 Chainz, Nelly, Shaquille O'Neal, Quavo, Killer Mike, Big Boi and others, as well as artists, dancers, and behind-the-scenes players who ensured its iconic status. The series offers an exclusive look into the enigmatic founder, Michael "Mr. Magic" Barney, and the lives of the many women responsible for building the club's mystique.
title: Magic City: An American Fantasy

overview: Dive into the minds of some of the world's most skilled negotiators to understand what it takes to navigate a situation where one wrong move can prove deadly. What secrets can they reveal about the art of negotiation? Analyzing four life-and-death situations, meet the negotiators who have mastered the art of tact in the face of lethal circumstances.
title: Life or Death: The Negotiators

overview: Tan Yan, deputy publicity chief of Hongye City Police, faces a sudden shift from office to the frontline as political commissar of the SWAT team. A thinker by trade, he is thrown into a world of action and instinct, colliding head-on with Commander Liao Bufan, a seasoned fighter with a big personality. They clash, adapt, and finally join forces to solve a major case. Through the process, Tan Yan rediscovers his true calling as a police officer.
title: Sharp Turns

overview: To win the lead role in a BL series, eight different men go on a limited summer trip of 7 days and 6 nights, experiencing youthful, passionate, romantic, and heartfelt situations in various attractions. As the eight men get to know each other better through the journey, they take on different "BL script missions" to nurture their feelings and chemistry. In the final confession scene, they must choose each other in order to star in the BL series.
title: Love Casting

overview: Music, excitement and laughter! A new TNT show where the stars of show business will guess the hits of all time. Presenters Timur Rodriguez and Regina Todorenko will help the participants go through musical challenges full of humor and unexpected twists. In each issue, participants will compete in guessing songs, overcoming obstacles — from cover bands to children performing hits in their "own" language.
title: Большой хит

overview: Borneo, 1841. Sandokan is a pirate sailing the China Sea with his trusted companion Yanez. An ancient prophecy, his forbidden love for the beautiful Marianna, and the ruthless hunt unleashed by Lord Brooke, a bold English adventurer and in love with the same woman, lead the pirate to make a series of choices that will transform him into the "Tiger of Malaysia."
title: Sandokan

overview: A Russian crime drama series, based on the Sherlock Holmes detective stories by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle.
title: Шерлок Холмс

overview: Ten influencers. One house. One million pounds. All the Insiders have to do is complete the challenges and not blow the cash — easy, right?
title: Inside

overview: #Sтуденты is a humorous sketch comedy about what students face different universities. This is the body of a youth magazine with a bright, bold and cheerful world. As a student, you will see your friends 'characters' of any university: the rector of greedy, Woman, which love the whole course, addicted to computer games "geeks" vigilantes overestimate the significance of their work, self-confident fifth year, and many others. It combines effortless sketches, unexpected and absurd humor to youth.
title: #Sтуденты

overview: Upon arriving in heaven at the age of 80, Hae Sook reunites with her rejuvenated husband, Nak Joon, leading to a romance that transcends their earthly lives.
title: Heavenly Ever After

overview: In the Blocco, gang clashes see confronting Bea, torn between her role as Segundera and her hope for a normal life, and Mahdi, who tries hard to cover the void left by his uncle. Between them is a gang of brash young boys, the Kasba: multi-ethnic, loud, irrepressible. Leading them are Zak and Nael, two 20-year-olds of Arab descent determined to make their own way, in music as in life. Ludo's return to town, hurt and lost after an event for which he bears the blame, leads Bea, Ludo and Mahdi to come to terms with the bond that each, in his own way, tries to deny. But together they are stronger: so between old friends and new enemies, the pressures of expectations and a life that seems to play with them as if they were pawns, Bea, Ludo and Mahdi unite again in a no-holds-barred adventure.
title: Gangs of Milano - Le nuove storie del Blocco

overview: Valentina leaves Patriarch's Ponds in search of a better life. New adventures of the brightest heroine of "Unprincipled"
title: Беспринципные в Питере

overview: Call My Agent tells comedic stories from a casting agency. Every day is full of work and human pitfalls. Trying to satisfy the demanding needs of acting stars, a constant battle with competition, complicated personal relationships that often get mixed up in work matters. The agency team has to manage all of this and survive the daily struggle that brings with it many absurd and comical situations, as well as touching moments and real human dramas.
title: Vytoč mého agenta

overview: Веселый скетчком от отечественного производителя. Вы найдете тут гастарбайтеров Равшана и Джамшута, больше пригодных для разрушений, чем для строительства. Вам покажут прожигателей жизни Славика и Димона, идущих на любые ухищрения ради взрослых развлечений. Вы близко познакомитесь с мечтами фрезеровщика, влюбленного в своего начальника. Вас поразит метаморфоза рублевских бомжей в депутатов. Ангельски честный инспектор ГИБДД Лаптев и многие другие неожиданные персонажи на просторах нашей Великой Раши. Современные былины рождаются тут.
title: Наша Russia

overview: A drama depicting the turbulent and eventful growth period of three friends; one rich, one poor, and one who wants to be rich, and their families.
title: Catch Your Luck

overview: Changing Planet, a 7-year PBS project, follows Dr. M. Sanjayan as he investigates the planet's most vulnerable ecosystems and the urgent efforts to help them survive climate change, revisiting six key habitats and exploring innovative solutions
title: Changing Planet

overview: A network of bankers, lawyers and mega-rich investors are defrauding European treasuries of EUR146 billion. Two women try to stop it, but the states and the banks are intent on thwarting their efforts.
title: Andre folks penge

overview: Highlights from the announcement of the winning Irish Album of the Year 2024 at the live event in Vicar St.
title: RTÉ Choice Music Prize

overview: One desperate woman and four couples fighting over her unborn child.
title: Děcko

overview: An unfortunate mistake turns a conservative businessman into a star of environmentalists. Could this be a sign of a life-changing event?
title: Limity

overview: Ima is a single mother with a high school daughter. She has fallen in love again. The other person is Hisame, a graduate student about a decade younger than her. The two are attracted to each other, regardless of their age or circumstances. However, she already has a high school daughter and two other lovers. Ima, who does not feel jealous even if her partner has another lover, has taken the form of a "multiple love" with the consent and understanding of all involved, which is a free relationship but is definitely different from betrayal such as adultery or cheating.
title: If She Calls It Love

overview: In the real-life soap Only Joling, Gerard is followed in the run-up to his 65th birthday and his 40th anniversary in the entertainment world and that is of course accompanied by many hilarious and extravagant moments.
title: Only joling

overview: One day, Mitsuda Takuzo is approached by his ex-girlfriend, Yanoguchi Mia, and her current boyfriend, Satomura Shinpei, who propose the idea of a "three-person marriage". Initially, Takuzo dismisses the idea as absurd, but he gradually agrees to a one-year trial period of shared living. As they navigate this unconventional arrangement, the trio faces numerous challenges, including setting boundaries for their sexual relationships, managing jealousy, and explaining their situation to their parents. Through it all, they strive to define their own version of happiness.
title: Three Person Marriage

overview: When a retired farther and his daughter from Mumbai moves into a house in a village rumored to be haunted faces paranormal activities. They must uncover the secret with the help of Sreenivas, a friend of the daughter.
title: Guddada Bhootha

overview: More than a third of people in the Czech Republic are single. A dating probe will reveal the reality of how we in the Czech Republic today are looking for a relationship, partnership, and maybe even love.
title: Mise hledání lásky

overview: Kathi is starting a new chapter in life.Her daughter Lilly is almost grown, and her husband has left. As a pedicurist in a small salon, she meets the people of Marzahn—many of whom go days without real conversation and pour out their hearts the moment they step inside.They cherish every touch, grateful for a place where they feel seen and respected.With each encounter, Kathi rediscovers herself, realizing that happiness is a choice. More and more, she understands that this salon has saved her. Starring Jördis Triebel, Yvonne Yung Hee Bormann, and Deborah Kaufmann, this six-part miniseries is directed by rising star Clara Zoë My-Linh von Arnim ("Die Zweiflers") and based on the autofictional bestseller by Katja Oskamp.
title: Marzahn Mon Amour

overview: Varya's life is like a fairy tale. She does what she loves, working as a pastry chef, and marries Ilya, with whom she dreams of spending her whole life. It seems that nothing and no one can ruin their happiness... But Alina, Varya's older sister, has other plans. Unlike her relative, Alina is unhappy in her marriage, although at first glance it is not noticeable. The envious and insidious woman is ready to do anything to get Varya's husband, even if it means resorting to black magic. However, Ilya's love spell turns into a real nightmare for both families.
title: Приворот

overview: Dasha gets a job as a housekeeper for a successful restaurant owner, Lydia. The girl quickly gains the trust of the powerful businesswoman, but her appearance in the house has its own reasons. In fact, Dasha is Lydia's sister, about whom she knew nothing, but the heroine is in no hurry to immediately reveal the whole truth. However, family secrets of the past begin to emerge when Lydia disappears. It turns out that Dasha was not the only one who had a motive for revenge on Lydia. But despite everything, only she sincerely wants to find her sister...
title: Исчезнувшая

overview: In the heart of the Alentejo countryside, Mariana and José Diogo are two children whose backgrounds could not be more different: she is the fruit of a loving relationship; he's an orphan. She has a safe haven in her family to run to when she gets hurt; he can only run to her.
title: A Protegida

overview: Members of an oceanographic expedition made up of scientists and the Spanish Navy embark on the Pentonkontors ship to investigate and raise awareness of the problems of the plastic island located in the South Pacific. It's time to get to grips with the situation and the freedom of the planet. It is important to know that your habitation for military personnel is good, so that you can prepare for your habitation and survival so that you can survive your daily life at Point Nemo. A place full of mysteries and lurking dangers.
title: Punto Nemo

overview: Desert Doc is a Prime Video series that offers a behind-the-scenes look at Medical Center Hospital, a remote and high-level trauma center in West Texas. The 13-episode series follows Dr. Sudip Bose, a combat veteran and emergency physician, as he and his team navigate challenging medical situations. The series covers topics such as the opioid crisis, oil field accidents, the aftermath of the Odessa mass shooting, and West Texas heat waves.
title: Desert Doc
